column1: # Wave hook enforcement rule reasons. Precedence (high→low): W-STATE, W-NESTED, W-FORK, W-TAG, W-MODE, W-ROLE, W-MODEL-MISSING, W-TIER, W-SCOPE, W-COND, W-ORDER, W-ARTIFACT, W-MARKER, W-DR-OPEN, W-VISUAL, W-BF-APPROVAL, W-ROUND, W-PASTE, W-BUDGET, W-EDIT, W-READ, W-BASH, W-COMMIT-DOC, W-COMMIT-TRAILER, W-LONG-RETURN, W-MODEL-UNKNOWN, W-DESC, W-PROMPT, W-TAINT, W-DOWNGRADE, W-RESOLVE-UNKNOWN

column3: printf_template
[W-STATE] %s; remedy: verify .wave/state.json is valid, readable and contains required keys — run `scripts/wave-set.sh` to fix scope flags.
[W-NESTED] nested dispatch from agent %s; remedy: the orchestrator is the single dispatcher; return your result and let it dispatch the reviewer.
[W-FORK] fork dispatch inherits orchestrator context and cannot be model-routed; remedy: dispatch a typed subagent with an explicit model instead.
[W-TAG] dispatch missing tag [W:%s P:PHASE R:role]; remedy: prefix description with [W:<wave> P:<PHASE> R:<lead|executor|reviewer|scanner|writer>] or put it on prompt's first line.
[W-MODE] %s is %s-mode only; remedy: this wave is in %s mode; the five demo phases are: AC, DR, TDE-RED, TDE-GREEN, TEET.
[W-ROLE] role %s does not exist in %s; remedy: this phase has: %s; check `hooks/roles.tsv` for framework role mappings.
[W-MODEL-MISSING] dispatch names no model; remedy: specify model: <haiku|sonnet|opus|fable> (minimum for %s/%s: %s).
[W-TIER] model %s (tier %s) is below %s/%s minimum (%s); remedy: use a model with tier %s or higher.
[W-SCOPE] cannot proceed without %s set; remedy: run `scripts/wave-set.sh %s true|false` to answer the scope question.
[W-COND] condition `%s` is false, so %s is skipped in this wave; remedy: %s.
[W-ORDER] predecessor(s) not done: %s; remedy: %s require(s) %s to complete first.
[W-ARTIFACT] artifact %s is missing; remedy: %s must produce %s; if the phase ran, check whether it wrote the expected file.
[W-MARKER] marker `%s` not found in %s; remedy: the artifact must contain at least one line matching the marker regex.

[W-DR-OPEN] design review has unanswered items: %s OPEN line(s) in .wave/dr.md against %s RESOLVED line(s) in .wave/approvals/dr-open.md; unanswered: %s; remedy: before TDE-RED, answer every OPEN: line in .wave/dr.md by adding a matching RESOLVED: line in .wave/approvals/dr-open.md.
[W-VISUAL] visual approval required before %s; remedy: ui is true; create .wave/approvals/green-visual.md after reviewing .wave/screenshots/green-*.png.
[W-BF-APPROVAL] bug-fix approval required; remedy: create .wave/approvals/bf-%s.md naming the strategy before re-running %s.

[W-ROUND] state.rounds["%s/%s"] == %s: two rounds of this phase and role have already completed in this wave; remedy: create .wave/approvals/rerun-%s-%s.md to allow a third, or surface the repeated failure to the user instead of retrying blindly.
[W-PASTE] prompt contains a %s-character block (the threshold is 4000) byte-identical to %s; remedy: the subagent can read .wave/ files itself; remove the pasted content.
[W-BUDGET] %s exceeded budget (spent %d, limit %d, %sx); remedy: create .wave/approvals/budget-%s.md approving the overage, or refactor the phase.
[W-EDIT] source file %s is tracked by git and not under .wave/; remedy: this is orchestrator-only session mode; read-only analysis lives outside the project; code edits via subagent dispatch.
[W-READ] cannot read %s from orchestrator (inside the project, outside .wave/); remedy: use Grep/Glob to locate it, then read via a subagent that returns conclusions, not file contents.
[W-BASH] %s is a build/test command not permitted here; remedy: dispatch a subagent to run tests/builds; the orchestrator drives the workflow, subagents do the work.
[W-COMMIT-DOC] cannot commit %s (planning document); remedy: analysis/handoff/checkpoint docs belong outside the repo in .wave/reports/; or create .wave/approvals/commit-doc.md to allow it.
[W-COMMIT-TRAILER] commit message carries attribution trailer; remedy: remove Co-Authored-By, Generated with, or session-URL lines; attribute via .wave/approvals/commit-doc.md instead.
[W-LONG-RETURN] return message exceeds 2000 characters (has %d); remedy: write the full report to `.wave/reports/%s-%s-%s.md` and return a summary.
[W-MODEL-UNKNOWN] model %s is unmapped to a known tier; remedy: mapping sees tokens: haiku, sonnet, opus, fable; the model may be valid or a new alias — allow it or update hooks/models.tsv.
[W-DESC] description is %d characters (exceeds 120-char recommendation); remedy: keep descriptions short; use the prompt's first line for the full tag if needed.
[W-PROMPT] prompt is %s characters, over the %s; remedy: lean context: move lengthy data to .wave/ files the subagent reads; it must not cross-pollute with orchestrator context.
[W-TAINT] agent used tier %s but dispatch required ≥%s (resolved %s); remedy: platform quota fallback or a fetch tool's built-in model; inspect transcript to confirm then proceed.
[W-DOWNGRADE] requested %s but resolved model is %s (tier downgraded); remedy: settings override may have downgraded the model; verify settings or explicitly name the higher tier.
[W-RESOLVE-UNKNOWN] resolved model %s could not be mapped to a tier; remedy: resolved model may be a new alias; update hooks/models.tsv or manually verify the tier in the transcript.
